Itaq; ex hac cōparatione intelligere promptum

alij paucioribus motibus circumagantur.
Quare in sphæra suprema stellæ sunt
innumerabiles, in singulis autem
inferioribus tantùm
singulæ?
Rationes duæ reddi possunt. Prior, à dignitate
supremæ sphæræ: Quo sphæra est dignior, eo pluri-
bus stellis ornari eam æquum est. Atqui suprema sphæ-
ra omnium dignissima est: igitur merito infinitis stel-
lis ornatur. Maior est manifesta. Minor probatur:
In prima sphæra est plus vitæ quam in reliquis, imò
ipsa est quasi vita omnium reliquarum, cum ab ea
vitis quasi influat in reliquas, cum item ipsa cōtineat
secumq; volvat omnes sphæras inferiores: deinde

page.notes: The page number reads "213" but the last digit is slightly unclear: [?]. The word "vitis" in "ab ea vitis quasi influat" may be a printing error for "vitæ"; left as printed. The line "ab ea vitis quasi influat" is the most doubtful reading. The "&" in "Sol & Luna" is printed as a ligature-like sign and is transcribed as &. The signature "o 3" is lowercase in print. The word "quasi" in "ipsa est quasi vita" is clear. The printed "Quo" and "Quare" have decorated initial Q forms, copied as plain letters. The question at the centre is set in larger type and is treated as a heading.
